g.text: Rank on risk to residents aged 65+
Rank 1 = most exposed / most at risk. Highlighted: the 6 countries whose rank moves most.
Spearman ρ = 0.775 across 30 OECD countries with at least three qualifying cities, 2020.
Exposure is not risk: the same countries, ranked two ways
Source: OECD CFE functional urban area dataflows (heat stress, urban heat island, green area, population by age), SDMX API. Cities > 100,000 residents.
